claims: Maintain lung-protective mechanical ventilation with low tidal volume and monitor plateau pressures and respiratory mechanics.
Wean inspired oxygen to target SpO2 88-95% and titrate PEEP to maintain adequate oxygenation while avoiding hyperoxia.
Assess and manage hemodynamic instability with hypotension and tachycardia, including titration of vasopressor support.
Recheck complete blood count and coagulation profile given leukocytosis with circulating blasts, thrombocytopenia, and coagulopathy.
Obtain daily chest radiograph to evaluate pulmonary infiltrates and ventilator support needs.
Monitor and correct electrolyte abnormalities including hyponatremia, hypokalemia, hypocalcemia, and hypophosphatemia.
Assess for tumor lysis syndrome with serial uric acid, potassium, phosphate, calcium, and renal function, and continue rasburicase or allopurinol prophylaxis as indicated.
Perform daily sedation interruption and delirium assessment targeting RASS 0 to -1, minimizing sedative exposure.
Provide stress ulcer prophylaxis and assess gastrointestinal motility given ileus risk and enteral feeding tube.
Continue broad-spectrum antimicrobial coverage and monitor for signs of infection with daily cultures and inflammatory markers.
